delivery_target: Younger to middle adult male; smooth, connected explanation. No pitch shifting. Perceived age and naturalness require listening acceptance.

phrases.text: Yes. Register alpha in context A, and beta in B. Each independent context has its own registry.
A finds alpha, but beta is missing. Sharing one Java application doesn't connect these registries.
Create a fresh parent and child. Set the parent before refreshing the child. The registries stay separate.
The child checks locally first. A missing named bean can be found in its parent.
The parent cannot search its children. Our tests confirm both directions: child to parent works; parent to child doesn't.
